schemaNote: v2 (extractor rebuild, Phase 5): Grounded.id is OPTIONAL (an id-less cell is text-graded and skipped by the entity gate); GoldPlan.sport may be a list of acceptable sports; GoldPlan.combined_odds added and graded hard; player subjects may omit `name` (generic per-player market), mirroring schema.ts decision 21.

decks.gold.seed.jsonl: 14 hand-authored, catalog-GROUNDED rows (real criterion + entity ids). Drives the entity and market-resolution gates.
decks.gold.corpus.jsonl: 289 generated rows across 37 sports, expanded from planning/corpus/gold-expect.jsonl by `npm run gold`. Text-graded, no ids. Regenerate freely — it never touches the seed.

validationNote: E11: at eval start every Grounded.id is checked against the loaded catalog. A missing id => 'stale gold -- re-author'; that cell is skipped, never counted as an AI failure. Corpus rows carry no ids and are exempt by construction.
